lines.t: And still the thirst of this people is not quenched
Peoples fill the streets and the alleyways
No light breaks through the open spaces
The darkness grows and is very thick
The light of life dims as their hearts grow cold
For there is no hope in man
And loving one another has no place in man's designs
For natural affection departs from the hearts of the wicked
And perversion is praised and celebrated
As the innocent look upon them with wonder.
